patch_description: Replace the nearly-zero fixed tail reward with an annealed low-tail objective. Early generations receive a meaningful reward for improving the eight smallest triangle areas, which discourages fragile configurations dominated by many nearly-degenerate triples and helps escape poor maximin basins. The reward then decays to a small tie-breaking term, so the latter part of the search is focused on the actual minimum-area metric. Rankings are recomputed under the current coefficient each generation, avoiding comparison of stale scores produced with different objectives.
